class: A list presented as the owner's fresh jobs was built from a fixed, narrow source and said nothing about when a job was posted, so the owner could not see the jobs they applied for or tell new from old
symptom: The agent could not fetch recent jobs matching the profile. The owner saw nothing from Workday, ADP, iCIMS or the other systems they apply through; the last scan was days old; and jobs already applied to or rejected were still on the page.
site: job_discovery.py and the Suggested jobs section of web_ui.py, 2 November 2026
root_cause: The scan could read only Greenhouse and Lever job lists, and only for twelve tech companies in a fixed file, while the owner's applications went mostly through Workday, Ashby, iCIMS and others that were never read. No job carried a posting date, so nothing could be filtered by how recently it was posted. Jobs the owner had skipped, been disqualified from, or had in progress were not recognised as already dealt with, because only sent applications counted and they were marked rather than left out.
why_tests_missed: Discovery tests fed rows that were already in the database and checked ordering, expiry and scoring; none asked which systems a scan could read, whether the employers the owner actually applies through were among them, whether a job carried a date, or what a time window would show.
fix: New readers (discovery_sources.py) for Workday, Ashby and iCIMS beside Greenhouse and Lever, each returning when the job was posted as exactly as the system says (an exact time, or a day held as the earliest it could be, so a job is only called recent when it certainly is). The employers to scan are taken from the applications already made as well as the owner's list. Each job's posting date is stored; the page offers the last hour, 24 hours, 3 days and week, newest first, and a job with no known date is never in a window. Any job with a record in the owner's history, whatever its status, is left out, as is anything dismissed. ADP is left out until it gives a link that opens a single job.
prevention: A list sold as fresh says when each item was posted, comes from the places the owner actually uses (taken from their history, not a fixed file), and filters on a date it can prove. Anything the owner has already dealt with, in any way, is not offered again.
